title: Mega Man Zero 2
collection: Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection · GBA
intro: A mission route with the health upgrades, Sub Tanks, equipment and rank decisions explained before you need them.
primer: Zero 2 restores ordinary lives and continues, and opens missions in two groups of four. Visit Cerveau after the introduction for Chain Rod and Shield Boomerang. Weapons still level through use; elemental charged attacks need the appropriate weapon level.

Collect the two physical Sub Tanks first: they do not penalize rank. Two more tanks and permanent health upgrades come from grown, consumed elves, which do penalize rank. The choice is between a forgiving survival run and a stricter score run.

EX Skills require A or S rank when entering the mission. Earning A at the end affects the next mission; it cannot award the skill you just missed. Forms also have first-clear conditions. Ordinary returns collect items but do not replay those rewards.

Save before a mission if you want to retry its rank, form or EX reward. New Game+ keeps acquired equipment so missed rewards can be pursued on another run. Save the clear data in a spare slot if you want to preserve your endgame save.
routeIntro: Hyleg first gives a physical tank. Poler requires neutral charged attacks here, then Ice handles Panter and Thunder handles Phoenix. Complete the two fixed intermissions. Burble supplies the second physical tank; finish the remaining guardians with their elemental weaknesses.

warning.title: Want every EX Skill or form? Save before each first clear.
warning.text: A/S is checked on entry. Mission rewards cannot be earned by ordinary revisits. Permanent elf use lowers future scores; choose health upgrades on a survival save, or preserve a separate save for rank and completion rewards.

features: Optional combat techniques, not required for the ending. Enable them in the menu after earning them.
Change stats and some attacks. Only one eligible form is awarded per mission; competing conditions have a priority order.

stages.name: Mecha Scorpia
stages.reward: Resistance Base; Chain Rod and Shield Boomerang from Cerveau
stages.tip: Attack the exposed tail when it comes within reach. Move away from falling debris, then return for the next opening.

items.name: Arnue · permanent extra lives
items.text: After the pair of vulture robots, let the crumbling pillars collapse and descend into the recess beneath them. Break the concealed elf capsule.
items.extra: Grow with 300 crystals. Using Arnue adds two lives to the starting count, with a lasting elf penalty.

stages.name: Hyleg Ourobockle
stages.tip: Strike between the snake-floor changes. Rescue the Reploids and keep clear of the grabbing attack.
stages.now: Physical Sub Tank 1 · Yeppie · health increase · Putick · hazard protection

items.name: Physical Sub Tank 1
items.text: Near the rescuable Reploid above the spikes, pull a block down onto the spike floor with Chain Rod. Cross left using it as a foothold.

items.name: Yeppie · health increase
items.text: Break the capsule concealed in the tree foliage near the start.
items.extra: 250 crystals to grow; using it adds 4 health and an elf penalty.

items.name: Putick · hazard protection
items.text: Collect the elf after defeating Pinofeil. Grow both stages before using it.
items.extra: Makes spikes and lava survivable, but still damaging; permanent elf penalty.

stages.name: Poler Kamrous
stages.reward: Ice Chip + Triple Shot · A/S entry
stages.tip: Avoid the ice trail, let him pass, then attack from behind.
stages.now: Fuppie · health increase · Atti · climbing · Fubuffa · no recoil

items.name: Fuppie · health increase
items.text: Break the capsule in the upper-right corner of the ice Golem room.

items.name: Atti · ladder speed
items.text: Defeat four Rollin-22 enemies and collect the drop.
items.extra: 70 crystals; climbs ladders faster, with a permanent elf penalty.

items.name: Fubuffa · no recoil
items.text: Defeat four Ice Lifters and collect the drop.

sprite.name: Poler Kamrous
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Panter Flauclaws
stages.reward: Thunder Chip + Spark Shot · A/S entry
stages.tip: Use Ice to interrupt her while avoiding the moving train hazards. Destroy the designated supplies.

sprite.name: Panter Flauclaws
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Phoenix Magnion
stages.tip: Use Thunder at openings and destroy all assigned generators.
stages.now: Grandie · doubled health · Dable · larger refills

items.name: Grandie · doubled health
items.text: Take the capsule on the first upward branch of the stage.
items.extra: 300 then 700 crystals; using it doubles health with a lasting elf penalty.

items.name: Dable · larger refills
items.text: Collect the elf after defeating U4.
items.extra: Grow with 200 then 500 crystals; energy pickups become more effective.

sprite.name: Phoenix Magnion
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Residential assault
stages.tip: Complete the required rescue and protect the Reploids before the aerial pursuit.

items.name: Estan · elf Sub Tank
items.text: In the right corner behind the movable block, use Chain Rod to pull the block aside and break the capsule.
items.extra: 400 crystals to grow; consuming it creates a tank and an elf penalty.

stages.name: Kuwagust Anchus
stages.tip: Protect Ciel by holding Shield Boomerang without throwing it. Slash enemies that slip past, then fight Anchus with Ice.

items.name: Peatan · elf Sub Tank
items.text: Take the upper passage above the electric-field box and collect the capsule.
items.extra: 400 crystals; consuming it creates a tank and an elf penalty.

stages.name: Burble Hekelot
stages.tip: Keep space for his leaps and attack after he lands.
stages.now: Physical Sub Tank 2 · Mappie · health increase · Kelon · jump height

items.name: Physical Sub Tank 2
items.text: After the miniboss, preserve the movable block and use it over the first spikes. Pull away the blocking cube with an upward-diagonal Chain Rod, then dodge it as it falls.

items.name: Mappie · health increase
items.text: Find the concealed passage below the ruins entrance and break the capsule.

items.name: Kelon · wall grip
items.text: Defeat five Catapulls and collect the elf.
items.extra: 150 crystals; slows wall sliding, with a permanent elf penalty.

sprite.name: Burble Hekelot
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Fairy Leviathan
stages.tip: Use Flame between her underwater lunges. Move carefully around the spike slopes.

stages.name: Sage Harpuia
stages.tip: Use Ice to interrupt his attack; dash to a safe landing point before the next strike.

items.name: Charnue · permanent extra lives
items.text: At the first outdoor spike pit, slide partway down and dash-jump through the false wall on the right. The alcove contains the capsule and a life pickup.
items.extra: 300 crystals; using it adds two starting lives and a lasting elf penalty.

stages.name: Fighting Fefnir
stages.tip: Use Thunder, clear the ground fire and strike before his next lunge.

items.name: Euppie · health increase
items.text: Below the large green cannon Pantheon, climb down the ladder and take the capsule.

items.name: Jettah · speed
items.text: Defeat three Hammer Pantheons and collect the drop.

returnIntro: Revisit cleared areas from the base for equipment and supplies. Keep a separate save before a one-time mission or the final assault.
completionText: Three elemental chips, four weapons, two physical tanks; two elf tanks and five health elves if using them. For completion, check forms and all ten EX Skills on a first-clear/New Game+ run. Arnue and Charnue are optional permanent lives upgrades, with the same lasting elf penalty.

sections.title: Forms and their first-clear conditions
sections.html:
Meet these conditions during an active mission, then finish it. If several qualify, priority is Energy → X → Defense → Erase → Active → Power → Rise.

FormCondition
EnergyCollect 25 life capsules
XDefeat 50 enemies with Buster
DefenseDefeat 20 with charged Shield Boomerang
EraseReflect 30 shots with the shield
ActiveDefeat 20 with dash Saber slashes
PowerPull objects 30 times with Chain Rod
RiseDefeat 20 with aerial Saber slashes
ProtoComplete the game
UltimateFind, grow and use every Cyber-elf

These are optional targets. Use a spare save if a form attempt prevents a clean mission clear.

sections.title: Neo Arcadia
paragraphs: Rainbow Devil MK-II awards Filter Shield with A/S entry; use neutral charged attacks against its head. Fire temple Fefnir remains weak to Thunder, Ice temple Leviathan to Flame, Wind temple Harpuia to Ice.
Use Ice against the twin Anchus in the rematch section; their health is shared. Stand in the center of a teleporter and press Up to enter it.
Elpizo: wait for his guard to open and use charged Saber. In the second form, move away from the center’s attacks and approach only for a prepared strike. Bring filled tanks.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Explore cleared stages for crystals and weapon practice outside the scored mission. Save afterward so the gains are retained.
Chain Rod pulls blocks, grapples and swings. Charge it to drain ordinary enemies with Energy Chain when that EX Skill is enabled.
